# Microsoft Entra Conditional Access Overview

Local summary of Microsoft Learn: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/overview

## Policy engine

Microsoft Entra Conditional Access is a policy engine that evaluates signals such as user, device, location, application and detected risk. Policies can require actions such as multifactor authentication, compliant device checks or blocking access.

## MFA enforcement

A common Conditional Access pattern is requiring MFA when users access Microsoft 365, Azure or other sensitive resources. Organizations should test policies before broad rollout and avoid excluding emergency access accounts from documented governance.

## Relevance for Ragzor

Ragzor Assistant uses this source as external vendor guidance when users ask about current Microsoft identity protection recommendations. Internal procedures remain the authority for company-specific steps.
